sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233563 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: 2026 peak season (Apr 1 - Oct 31): $24 non-electric, $34 electric (one double electric site $68); outside it the walk-in rate is $20 for any site. 50% off with a Senior or Access pass. Day-use fee of $7 is waived for campers holding a reservation.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233563/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24, STANDARD ELECTRIC 34; First-come, First-served Season: 20) + campground notices

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233563 (notice: 'Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground and cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees')

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233563 (fetched 2026-10-20): 117 bookable sites list 50-amp and 13 list 30-amp electric; 131 bookable sites list a water hookup. rec.gov amenities: Electric Hookups, Water Hookups

values.note: Hot showers and flush toilets (listed as seasonal), dump station, drinking water. Each camping area has its own swim beach. Gas, groceries and firewood within 2 miles.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233563 (Facilities description: 'hot showers, flush toilets and a dump station'; amenities: Drinking Water, Dump Station, Showers (Seasonal), Flush Toilets (Seasonal))

values.note: Maximum stay 14 days within any 30-day period. recreation.gov's rate table runs a peak (reservable) season April 1 - October 31 and a 'First-come, First-served Season' in winter (2026: from November 9). Check-in 4 pm; checking in after the gatehouse closes is prohibited.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233563 (notice: 'Maximum stay is 14-days within any 30 day period'; facility_rules maxStay 14 nights rolling 30 days) + /rates season names

values.note: 233 bookable sites in the recreation.gov catalog (131 electric, 101 non-electric, plus group areas), and 13 management sites. Listed max vehicle lengths run to 50 ft, most 30-45; 14 pull-throughs.

summary: Confirmed $20-34 fees (2026 rate table: $24 non-electric/$34 electric peak, $20 walk-in off-season), 50-amp electric and water at sites, Senior/Access 50% discount. Added 14-night max stay, facilities (showers, flush toilets, dump, water), 233 sites up to 50 ft with pull-throughs. Not stated: sewer, booking window beyond the agency default, season dates in prose (only rate-season names), fcfs as a policy statement. rec.gov facility_rules also carries a 'militaryDiscount' flag with no prose; not recorded.
